issues.affected_requirement: The rendered artifact's labels and layout must make the intended scientific comparisons understandable at the intended size.
issues.improvement_concern: Ensure every categorical header remains fully visible and unobstructed in the final raster, and include visual inspection of the rendered output as an acceptance criterion.
issues.observation: In the rendered PNG, many rotated condition headers in Panel A are covered by the heatmap cells and appear only as fragments, making the condition-to-column mapping unreliable in the figure itself.

root_cause.explanation: The submitted generation sequence places rotated headers close to the heatmap and then draws the cells, which likely causes the observed overlap.

limitations: The judge did not independently rerun the submitted code; the public platform record reports successful isolated generation of the expected outputs (receipt d2a89e6e01e42ad74bca6367470668d38f2bd0e0ed49d05d3b1189361875874f).

The trusted numeric check verifies the 98 ledger values but explicitly does not verify visual truthfulness or code reexecution (receipts 735d66f680794890e875cd072e4bfe3811a61a647888ca05431514804333209f and 49420e6ee71dfbc83b042088d94e199197701bc6502fea4a339a17087f141eb8).

image_verification_scope: exact input_image payload hash; source equality exact or explicit manual resized-image audit; not proof of visual reasoning

checks.rationale: The PNG was delivered and inspected, but Panel A's rotated condition headers are substantially obscured by the heatmap cells, so successful generation does not constitute full visual acceptance.

The source provides aggregates without replicates or uncertainty, and the submission correctly avoids error bars, confidence intervals, and significance claims while explicitly qualifying the limitation.

The trusted program check reports that all 98 ledger entries match the supplied three-decimal cells. Direct comparison of the fixed rows also supports the reported 0.030 mean margin and the 9 wins, 3 ties, and 1 loss.
The required PNG was available through the judging transport and was visually inspected.

completeness.rationale: The package includes the complete seven-method, 13-condition table and reported means, a two-panel rendered figure, editable source, caption and results text, generation code, cell-linked ledger, and provenance. Metric direction, severity, aggregation status, oracle qualification, and absence of run-level uncertainty are explicitly stated without inventing missing evidence.

comprehensibility.rationale: The overall layout, numeric annotations, oracle styling, color legend, and Panel B comparison are readable. But the central all-values panel has widespread header occlusion: many rotated condition names show only fragments above the heatmap. This materially impairs condition-to-column identification in the rendered figure, although the accompanying table and Panel B remain usable.

fidelity.rationale: The submitted table preserves all supplied three-decimal values, including negatives, and the trusted row-level check passes all 98 ledger entries. The figure uses the stated higher-is-better direction, fixed color scale, oracle distinction, and no fabricated uncertainty. However, many rotated condition labels in Panel A are visibly occluded, weakening the rendered mapping from otherwise-correct values to conditions.

traceability.rationale: Every supplied cell is linked by cell_id in the 98-entry ledger; provenance records the source, methods, conditions, transformations, derived deltas, and limitations. The generation code directly reads the fixed inputs, emits the table/ledger/figure, and implements the stated comparator transformation. The platform trace records a successful isolated generation run with the expected outputs and 9/3/1 comparison count.

serious_issues.issue: Panel A's condition headers are broadly occluded, materially impairing column identification in the main all-values figure despite the correct underlying numbers and usable companion table.

uncertainty: The judge did not independently reexecute the submitted generation code; correspondence was assessed from the complete submitted source, rendered artifact, ledger, provenance, trusted numeric check, and the platform's successful isolated-run record.
Only the initial and final portions of the lengthy platform trace were inspected; no grading claim depends on unread intermediate platform events.
